fieldA.label: Field A
fieldA.placeholder: Type a name, e.g. "Priya" — checks the Users API on keyup
fieldA.helpText: On keyup, calls the Users API for a matching name. A match disables Field B and puts Field C into an error state. Clear it to release both.

fieldB.label: Field B
fieldB.placeholder: Disables on a match; otherwise filled in from Field A
fieldB.helpText: Driven entirely by Field A's onKeyUp handler -- try nothing here.

fieldC.label: Field C
fieldC.placeholder: Shows an error once Field A's keyup lookup finds a match
fieldC.helpText: Still editable -- only its error state is controlled by Field A's onKeyUp handler.
fieldC.dependencyError: Field C is invalid -- Field A matches an existing user.

fieldD.label: Field D (checkbox)
fieldD.helpText: Same event standard as the text fields -- watch the log for onCheckedChange, onClick, onKeyDown, etc.

fieldE.label: Field E (select)
fieldE.helpText: Same standard -- click/focus/keydown on the trigger, plus onValueChange.

fieldF.label: Field F (switch)
fieldF.helpText: Same standard as Field D's checkbox.

fieldG.label: Field G (textarea)
fieldG.placeholder: Multi-line text -- full event set, incl. paste/copy/cut/select
